build_pipeline_with_builder: build a data processing pipeline using PipelineBuilder with add_source, pipe, and add_sink methods
add_source_to_pipeline: add an iterable or async iterable source to a PipelineBuilder with optional continuous mode
pipe_operation_in_pipeline: apply a transformation operation to pipeline items with configurable concurrency and output order
aggregate_items_in_pipeline: buffer and aggregate pipeline items into batches using an integer count or custom Aggregator
build_pipeline_with_config: build a Pipeline object from PipelineBuilder with thread count, max failures, and task hook settings
